label: Classical / Generic
description: Formulation and method drawn from a First-Schedule authoritative text. Largely traditional knowledge; faces the Section 3(p) patent bar; defended via TKDL.

label: Proprietary Medicine
description: A named, marketed Ayurvedic medicine not drawn wholesale from a classical text, typically a branded combination product.

label: New / Non-classical Drug
description: Requires proof of safety and effectiveness; genuine patent potential if it clears Section 3(p) and 3(e).

label: Phytopharmaceutical
description: A plant-derived drug with a defined, standardized composition; a distinct regulatory category under the New Drugs and Clinical Trial Rules, 2019.

label: Ayurveda-Aahar / Nutraceutical
description: Regulated as a food under FSSAI's Ayurveda-Aahar regulations, not as a drug.

label: Cosmetic
description: Regulated under the cosmetic provisions of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, not its drug provisions.
